title: Kris Jenner gets laser treatment on vagina to make it 'perfect and cute'
text:

 Erin Jensen USA TODAY Nov. 19, 2026, 11:22 a.m. ET Hear this story The Kardashian - Jenner brood are no strangers to upkeep, and on the Nov. 19 episode of “The Kardashians” (Hulu, Thursdays), matriarch Kris Jenner revealed the extent of her self-care.
 While dining with best friend Shelli Azoff at Nate 'n Al's deli in Beverly Hills, Azoff asked what the rest of Jenner’s day entailed.
 “So I am going to Dr. A’s office to get a MonaLisa treatment,” Jenner, 71, told her friend, referring to her OB-GYN, Dr. Thaïs Aliabadi.
 “And what would a MonaLisa treatment be?” Azoff inquired with a smile on her face.
 “A MonaLisa treatment is a laser in your vagina,” Jenner replied simply, but her friend needed more details. Elaborating, Jenner said the procedure "makes it really perfect and cute and other lovely things."
 Watch it here: Stream your favorite shows, the biggest blockbusters and more. Khloe Kardashian discusses demisexuality. What is that? “You tell me how that works,” Azoff told her friend with detectable sarcasm.
 “It’s great!” Jenner raved, noting that she's had the procedure done before. The revelation that made her confidant burst into laughter.
 “Live a little for God’s sake,” Jenner said lightheartedly.
 The MonaLisa Touch is performed with a CO₂ fractional laser, according to its website , and aims to prevent and lessen “the effects of oestrogen decrease on vaginal tissues (typical of many conditions like menopause and post-partum) rehydrating and nourishing tissues, reactivating new collagen production and restoring the correct vaginal microbiome with acid pH.”
 Per Dr. Aliabadi’s website , the laser causes “tiny micro-injuries that stimulate the body’s natural healing process.” Three sessions, lasting no more than five minutes each, are scheduled with six weeks between appointments.

As the momager explained to Vogue Arabia for its September 2025 issue , she's all for intervention.
 “I decided to do this facelift because I want to be the best version of myself, and that makes me happy," Jenner told the outlet . "Just because you get older, it doesn’t mean you should give up on yourself. If you feel comfortable in your skin and you want to age gracefully – meaning you don’t want to do anything – then don’t do anything. But for me, this is ageing gracefully. It’s my version.”
